rule.signal: Form 4/5 non-derivative transaction code P (open-market or private purchase) of common equity or ADR, with a reported share count and price, aggregated per filing per ticker
rule.entry: regular-session OPEN of the first trading day strictly after the SEC filing date — never the insider's own fill price
rule.exit: none — positions stay open for forward testing
rule.lookahead: none — no price at or before the filing date is used as a fill
rule.costs: no commission, slippage or spread modelled
rule.prices: Yahoo Finance daily bars, Stooq fallback
rule.splits: split-adjusted series; insider prices are as-filed
